        4 persist together through fresh reloads and render on the card.

steps.name: Step 1 — Create form: add tags "tag1", "tag2" before the first Save
Step 2 — Save and verify the POST returns 201 with both pre-save tags in the payload
Step 3 — Re-open the Skill (fresh load) and verify both tags persisted
Step 4 — Add "tag3", "tag4" to the saved Skill (edit mode) and Save
Step 5 — Re-open the Skill (fresh load) and verify all 4 tags persist on both the form and the list card
